title: TPO: Tri-level Distributionally Robust Learning for OOD Direct Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.28229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) minimizes empirical risk over observed preference comparisons, implicitly assuming that the training preference distribution matches the deployment preference distribution. In practice, this i.i.d. assumption often fails, as preference distribution shift exhibits a natural hierarchical structure across three levels: group-level shift, prompt-level shift, and preference-level shift. Such multi-level distributional mismatch poses a critical challenge for safe LLM deployment, yet existing robust DPO methods typically either model uncertainty over the joint preference distribution or focus on individual sources of shift, leaving the hierarchical structure of OOD preference shifts underexplored. We propose TPO, a tri-level distributionally robust framework for OOD preference alignment, which jointly models all three levels of distributional uncertainty through a hierarchically structured rectangular ambi

translated_title: TPO：面向OOD直接偏好优化的三层分布鲁棒学习
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化在观测到的偏好比较数据上最小化经验风险，这隐含地假设训练时的偏好分布与部署时的偏好分布相匹配。然而在实践中，这种独立同分布假设经常失效，因为偏好分布漂移呈现出自然的三层层级结构：组级漂移、提示级漂移和偏好级漂移。这种多层次的分布失配对大语言模型的安全部署构成了关键挑战，但现有的鲁棒DPO方法通常要么对联合偏好分布的不确定性进行建模，要么仅关注单一来源的漂移，导致对OOD偏好漂移的层级结构探索不足。我们提出了TPO，一个面向OOD偏好对齐的三层分布鲁棒框架，它通过层级化结构的矩形模糊集联合建模所有三个层次的分布不确定性……
tldr: 提出了TPO框架，通过三层分布鲁棒学习同时建模组级、提示级和偏好级的分布不确定性，使DPO在分布外偏好漂移场景下更加鲁棒。
en_tdlr: TPO is a tri-level distributionally robust framework that jointly models group-level, prompt-level, and preference-level distributional shifts, making Direct Preference Optimization robust to out-of-distribution preference shifts.
